title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 69 (Reimbursement of person paying money due by another, in payment of which he is interested)

content.overview: Section 69 provides that a person who is interested in the payment of money which another is bound by law to pay, and who therefore pays it, is entitled to be reimbursed by the other.
content.glance: Person interested in a payment which another is bound by law to pay, and who pays it → entitled to reimbursement by the other.
content.study: A person interested in the payment of money which another is bound by law to pay, and who therefore pays it, is entitled to be reimbursed by the other. Interest and legal obligation of the other are key. Current-law framing: identify the payer’s interest; identify the other’s legal obligation to pay; apply reimbursement.

sections.heading: Interested payer
sections.body: Person interested in payment of money which another is bound by law to pay, and who therefore pays it, is entitled to be reimbursed by the other.

provisions.title: Reimbursement of person paying money due by another, in payment of which he is interested

examples.title: Payment of another’s tax to protect interest
examples.body: A, interested in land, pays tax which B is bound by law to pay, to protect A’s interest. A is entitled to reimbursement from B under s. 69.

hypotheticals.question: Can a volunteer with no interest claim under s. 69?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 69 requires that the payer is interested in the payment.

distinctions.title: Scope of s-69
distinctions.body: Applies only within the elements and consequences stated in the statutory text.

misconceptions.trap: Anyone who pays another’s debt can always claim reimbursement.
misconceptions.correction: Section 69 requires that the payer is interested in the payment and the other is bound by law to pay.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 69 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify payer’s interest. II. Identify other’s legal obligation to pay. III. Apply reimbursement. IV. Conclude.

examTips: Stress interest of the payer and legal obligation of the other.
